name: Pomme
source:
Pomme is the village herbalist. She lives in the outskirts of the village and sells her medicine in her father's shop.

She is brave and soft hearted. She always tries to see the best in people even when it doesn't go her way.

Daughter of a witch she regrets not inheriting her mother's abilities and knowledge since she lost her when she was just a child.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3936920/The_Demons_Apple__Otome_Game/]Steam[/url]]
